nodes.title: Connector-configuration read responses answer configuration as a JSON string
nodes.summary: GET /v1/connectors/{connector} and GET /v1/connectors now both re-serialize the registry's held configuration object back to the JSON string domain/integration/connector-configuration declares, through one shared projection.

nodes.title: A capability can be read directly by its own (name, version) identity over HTTP
nodes.summary: Adds GET /v1/capabilities/{name}/{version}, calling CapabilityRegistryService existing readCapabilityByIdentity through a new route, controller and DTO, wired into build-app and mapped through status-map.ts with a fourth typed not-found error.

nodes.title: Connector-configuration read responses answer configuration as a JSON string
nodes.summary: Proves that GET /v1/connectors/{connector} and GET /v1/connectors both answer configuration as the JSON string domain/integration/connector-configuration declares, and that parsing what either answers reproduces the same JSON value the connector was registered with.

nodes.title: Proof for read-capability-by-identity-route
nodes.summary: Tests exercise GET /v1/capabilities/{name}/{version} in isolation and through buildApp(), proving the four criteria, the class-distinctness inference, the path-coexistence inference, and the edge cases the route's behavior raises.
